I just need to reach the end of the Training Forest, enter #bthe 2nd Drill Hall#k, and defeat the Tiguru inside while bringing back #t4032096#. I better find #b30 #t4032096#s#k and bring them back to #p1101003#. \n\n#i4032096# #t4032096# #b#c4032096# / 30#k
descriptions.completed: I have successfully completed the Knighthood Exam and officially dropped the "in-Training" from my title. As a bonafide Cygnus Knight, I shall do my best to work hard so I will never be ashamed of myself.
